items.title: Paramount Skydance launches $7.5B leveraged loan for Warner Bros Discovery acquisition
items.summary: A Citi-led arranger group has launched a $7.5 billion-equivalent cross-border term loan B split between a $6.5 billion US dollar tranche and a $1 billion-equivalent euro tranche as part of the debt financing package supporting the acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery (Nasdaq: WBD) by Paramount Skydance Corp. (Nasdaq: PSKY), according to sources.
